exposure: hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) shunt
cohort: The study included 86 preterm infants (54 hsPDA, 32 controls) born at <27 weeks' gestation and admitted at <24h postnatal age to a large quaternary referral.
finding: Exposure to hsPDA shunt is independently associated with an increased risk of a composite outcome of death or moderate-to-severe ROP, as well as any stage of ROP, among infants born at <27 weeks.
followup_time: until ROP assessment or death <32 weeks
birth_weight: N/A (hsPDA patients were lighter at birth)
